mapper.select: SELECT m.*, s.stadium_nm, f.field_nm, f.file_idx, fl.file_path, mt.match_type_nm, mt.total_players, min_lvl.tier AS min_level_name, max_lvl.tier AS max_level_name, mt.match_type_nm AS match_method, match_state.match_stts, p.`name` FROM matches m INNER JOIN match_types mt ON m.match_type_cd = mt.match_type_cd INNER JOIN levels min_lvl ON m.min_level_cd = min_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN levels max_lvl ON m.max_level_cd = max_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN `fields` f ON m.field_no = f.field_no INNER JOIN stadium s ON s.stadium_no = f.stadium_no INNER JOIN match_statuses match_state ON m.match_stts_no = match_state.match_stts_no INNER JOIN files fl ON f.file_idx = fl.file_idx INNER JOIN stadium st ON f.stadium_no = st.stadium_no INNER JOIN provinces p ON st.province_id = p.province_id WHERE m.match_stts_no = 1;

SELECT stadium_no, stadium_nm, stadium_addr, province_id, shower_use_psblty_yn, restroom_use_psblty_yn, parking_use_psblty_yn, has_shoe_rental, has_vest_rental, has_ball_rental, sells_drinks, stadium_telno, dtl_cn, oper_yn FROM stadium;

SELECT m.*, s.*, f.*, fl.file_path, mt.match_type_nm, mt.total_players, min_lvl.tier AS min_level_name, max_lvl.tier AS max_level_name, mt.match_type_nm AS match_method, match_state.match_stts, p.`name` FROM matches m INNER JOIN match_types mt ON m.match_type_cd = mt.match_type_cd INNER JOIN levels min_lvl ON m.min_level_cd = min_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN levels max_lvl ON m.max_level_cd = max_lvl.level_cd INNER JOIN `fields` f ON m.field_no = f.field_no INNER JOIN stadium s ON s.stadium_no = f.stadium_no INNER JOIN match_statuses match_state ON m.match_stts_no = match_state.match_stts_no INNER JOIN files fl ON f.file_idx = fl.file_idx INNER JOIN stadium st ON f.stadium_no = st.stadium_no INNER JOIN provinces p ON st.province_id = p.province_id WHERE m.match_no = 1;
SELECT * FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN provinces p ON s.province_id = p.province_id HAVING p.`name`=#{keyword};
SELECT * FROM `fields` f LEFT JOIN stadium s ON f.stadium_no = s.stadium_no HAVING s.stadium_no = #{staNo};
SELECT * FROM matches m INNER JOIN fields f ON m.field_no = f.field_no where m.field_no = #{fieldNo} and m.match_date = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO matches (field_no, match_date, match_time, match_end_time, min_level_cd, max_level_cd, match_stts_no, gender_nm, match_type_cd) VALUES (#{fieldNo}, #{matchDate}, #{matchTime}, #{matchEndTime}, #{minLevelCode}, #{maxLevelCode}, '1', #{gender}, #{matchType})
